meta.title: Custom Point of Sale System | Hyper Grid Studio
meta.description: Custom point of sale system, built and running in production. Sales and inventory management tailored to your business, not a generic template.

software_pos.intro: This isn't a demo or a mockup — it's the point of sale system I designed that's running in a real business today, handling sales and inventory every day. I'm showing it here as proof of what I can build for yours — not as an abstract promise to "build management systems."

sections.heading: What It Solves
sections.body: A custom point of sale system adapts to how your business actually works, instead of forcing you into someone else's workflow. It covers the essentials: sales tracking, real-time inventory control, billing reports, and multi-user or multi-register support — sized for a small business, not a corporation.

sections.heading: Why Not a Template
sections.body: Off-the-shelf platforms (like Square or generic POS SaaS) charge a monthly fee for features you may never use, and don't adapt as your business grows or changes. A custom system is built once, around how you actually work — no overpaying for what you don't need, no being boxed in by what the software allows.

sections.heading: Integrates With the Rest of Your Operation
sections.body: A point of sale system doesn't work in isolation: it can connect to <link1>automated low-stock alerts, WhatsApp reports, or customer reminders</link1> using the same automations I build for other businesses, or to a broader <link2>management system</link2> if you also need connected CRM or billing.

sections.heading: How We Work
sections.body: We start with a conversation about how your business runs today — what you sell, how you track stock, who handles checkout — and I design the system from there. <link1>See real case studies in the portfolio</link1> before deciding.

faq.q: How much does a custom point of sale system cost?
faq.a: Depends on scope (number of registers, whether you need advanced reporting or e-invoicing integration). Quoted after the initial conversation — no surprises, no fine print.

faq.q: Does it integrate with my current invoicing system?
faq.a: Yes, that's part of the custom design: it connects with what you already use instead of replacing everything at once.

faq.q: How long does it take to build?
faq.a: Varies by scope, but since it's a focused system (not a generic platform with extra features) development is faster than a full ERP.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: At Hyper Grid Studio we respect your privacy. This policy explains what data we collect, how we use it and what your rights are.
privacy.s1_body: When you fill out the contact form we collect your full name, email address and message. We do not collect any other personal data through the website.
privacy.s2_body: The data is used solely to respond to your inquiry. We do not use it to send advertising or unsolicited communications.
privacy.s3_body: We do not sell or share your information. Form messages are processed through Formspree. You can review their policy at formspree.io.
privacy.s4_body: This site does not use cookies or tracking technologies.
privacy.wa_intro: We offer Aliz, an assistant that lets you book appointments through WhatsApp. When you interact with our WhatsApp bot, the conditions described below apply.
privacy.wa_data_body: When you message the WhatsApp bot we collect: your phone number, your WhatsApp contact name, the content of the messages you send to the bot and the booking details you schedule (date and time).
privacy.wa_use_title: What we use that data for
privacy.wa_use_body: We use this data solely to manage appointment booking for the corresponding client business. It is not used for any other purpose.
privacy.wa_proc_body: Your data is processed through the Meta WhatsApp Business API (to send and receive messages), the Google Calendar API (to register the appointment in the business calendar) and the Anthropic (Claude) API (to interpret your booking request expressed in natural language).
privacy.wa_share_title: We do not share your data
privacy.wa_share_body: We do not sell or share your data with third parties beyond the service providers mentioned, which are strictly necessary for the bot to operate.
privacy.wa_retention_title: How long we keep the data
privacy.wa_retention_body: We keep conversation and appointment data for a maximum of 12 months, or until you request its deletion, whichever comes first.
privacy.wa_deletion_title: How to request deletion of your data
privacy.wa_deletion_body: You can request the deletion of your data at any time by writing to <mail></mail>. We will process your request promptly.
privacy.s6_body: The site has an SSL certificate (HTTPS); all information travels encrypted and securely.
privacy.s7_body: You can request access to or deletion of your data by writing to <mail></mail>.
privacy.s8_body: For any questions about this policy, write to <mail></mail>.
